model.description: Deck to cut (k-file). A master deck is read with its whole *INCLUDE closure, so the included files must sit where the deck points (on the platform: uploaded to the same session). If no elements are found even then, it is refused rather than producing an empty figure, and the console says which includes could not be read, with the include list

axis.description: Cut-plane normal. 'auto' excludes axes whose section collapses to a line, then takes the axis meeting the most parts, breaking ties on the section's bounding-box area. Perpendicular-to-the-stack is NOT the rule: on a measured 61-part battery stack z meets 2 parts while x and y meet 59, and on a wrapped deck it is the other way round

at.description: Plane position along the axis; omitted means the bounding-box centre. A plane landing exactly on a node layer — the layer boundary you most want to look at — is detected and nudged by epsilon, and both facts are reported

max_parts.description: Legend entries in the SVG before the rest are counted as omitted. The manifest and the polygons are never capped — every part the plane cut is emitted.

compare.description: Optional second deck drawn in the same figure. With mode=panels each deck picks its own axis and scale; with mode=overlay both are cut by the SAME plane (that is what an overlay means) and the second is drawn dashed. Node numbering is the pairing in this repo — linkage-fit and applyfold require matching node ids — so an overlay costs nothing to align

mode.description: panels = side by side, overlay = one frame

width.description: SVG width in px (>= 430: margins 70x2 + legend 260 + plot)

isotropic.description: true draws both axes at one scale. The default is anisotropic because a real stack is 1:9,375 across and its thinnest layer lands on a measured 0.081 px isometrically; the magnified axis and its factor are always written into the figure

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
